kind: reproduction of the attempt-1 non-overlap gate false positive (recorded after the fact)

with_script_name_in_parent_shell_command.matched: the direct parent /bin/zsh -c ... command line, whose text contained null_control_batch.py

reproduction.method: host_gates() called from '.venv/bin/python -c "import null_control_batch as N; N.host_gates()"' inside wrappers with and without the string in their command line; ps showed no dev_batch, coverage_batch, run.py --stage or other null_control_batch process

gate_defect: host_gates() excludes only its own PID, not ancestor shells, so a wrapper whose command line names the script trips the gate; the frozen code is unchanged. Launching attempt 2 via python -c (without the file name) also means a concurrent same-module python -c launch would not have been matched; no such process existed (the recorded ps scan found no simulation or stage job)
run_overwrite_note: run() writes gates.json and run_status.json without an overwrite guard; the attempt-1 records were preserved by renaming them before attempt 2
